title: Liquid Metal Particle활용 Stretchable PCB 제작
englishTitle: Stretchable PCBs using liquid metal particles
summary: Research on liquid-metal-particle stretchable interconnects, printed-process uniformity, and electrical reliability.
myContribution: Related first-author work examines how printed-film thickness contributes to initial trace-to-trace electrical variability and distinguishes that nonuniformity from resistance changes under repeated mechanical deformation.
